text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This won't do...
I have to tell Trainer properly.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm so sorry, Trainer.
I seem to have gained weight..."
choice_data_list: Is that so... Did something happen?
Is that so... Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was someone who never neglected self-management and was a total stranger to an unhealthy lifestyle. Wondering about the reason, I asked her—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I've been helping out with baking sweets
and cooking with my friends nonstop, so...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I end up eating too much when taste-testing.
I just really want to give them proper,
thoughtful feedback, you see."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I did consider turning down the
help altogether, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... Whenever I think it's a chance to help someone accomplish something, I just can't resist.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I consider it a great honor.
I truly want to stand by you and be of help...
choice_data_list: In that case, taste-testing is a must.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um... what sort of thing is that?
choice_data_list: On tasting days, I use the 'divided meals' approach.
On tasting days, I use the 'divided meals' approach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She can never refuse a taste test. If so, we can simply treat it as a supplemental snack and adjust her dinner portions accordingly.
choice_data_list: I'll think of a routine you can keep doing while helping out.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... That's fantastic!
Trainer, yes please, I would love that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa mastered managing calorie intake
while continuing to help out.
She succeeded in dieting in a healthy, reasonable way.
